paragraphs: OpenCV Studio is a high-performance, web-based image manipulation suite designed for rapid prototyping and creative editing. Leveraging advanced computer vision and AI-driven background removal, it provides a seamless "studio-grade" experience directly in your browser. The application features a handcrafted Gruvbox aesthetic, offering a focused and professional environment for visual experimentation.
features: Background Removal: High-accuracy foreground extraction using the U2Net model.
Professional Filters: Instant application of Grayscale, Gaussian Blur, and Canny Edge Detection.
Dynamic Adjustments: Real-time sliders for precise Brightness and Contrast normalization.
Smart Transformation: Intelligent resizing and high-fidelity compression for optimized exports.
Thematic Continuity: Hand-tuned Gruvbox Dark mode that persists across sessions.
